pairs.text_en: Energy equals mass times the speed of light squared
pairs.text_zh: 能量等于质量乘以光速的平方
力等于质量乘以加速度

pairs.text_en: The sum of squares of two legs equals the square of the hypotenuse
pairs.text_zh: 两条直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方

pairs.text_en: The sum of integers from 1 to n equals n times n plus 1 divided by 2
pairs.text_zh: 从1到n的整数和等于n乘以n加1除以2

pairs.text_en: The derivative of e to the x equals e to the x
pairs.text_zh: e的x次方的导数等于e的x次方

pairs.text_en: The integral of 1 over x is the natural log of the absolute value of x plus a constant
pairs.text_zh: 1除以x的积分等于x绝对值的自然对数加常数
